payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates all pairs (a,b) with a<=b<n, computes c^2=a^2+b^2, checks if c integer and ≤ n, prunes inner loop when c > n.
payload.rationale: Uses nested loops for exhaustive enumeration with an early break when the hypotenuse exceeds n, which is a simple branch-and-bound pruning. No backtracking or graph search.
